notes.title: Patch v0.2.6
notes.notes: [p]✨ [b]Features[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added auto-connect air pipe option in World Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added brakes prefill to 5 bars when placed, configurable in World Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed limiting dome in Fly Mode; objects now get teleported instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized world loading for better performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a new, more readable font.[/p][/*][/list][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the whole train wouldn’t fill to 5 bars when set, and other air brake issues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.5
notes.notes: [p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed turntable bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with two opposing switches, where destroying one also removed ballast under the other[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel station fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted cloud speed (they were too fast)[/p][/*][*][p]Other small tweaks (e.g., in main menu)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.4
notes.notes: [p]✨ [b]Features[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added option to [b]invert mouse Y-axis[/b] for first-person camera control.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]mouse sensitivity settings[/b] for better input customization.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]move platforms along the Y-axis[/b] while they are snapped to the track.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Train locomotive prices reduced to 70%[/b] to improve gameplay progression and experimentation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Improved [b]train physics[/b]: adjusted speed, friction, and overall motion for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]multiplayer player desync[/b] when standing on a moving train.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]platforms overlapping and flickering[/b], especially at [b]crossings over tracks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with [b]ladders not working correctly[/b] in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]scroll speed in UI ScrollViews[/b]—scrolling with the mouse was previously too slow.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.2
notes.notes: [p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed CHME3 RPM glitch causing it to accelerate too fast, while reverse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed front ladder on CHME3[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed levers in the locomotive misclicking during dragging[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted fix for station name input issue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed engine startup sound desynchronization in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where destroying a ladder with a player on it caused issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enter key triggering after placing signboards[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.1
notes.notes: [p]✨ Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added Super Flat world type[/p][/*][/list][p]🐛 Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]ChME3 high beams fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Switches no longer toggle randomly in fly mode or engine view[/p][/*][*][p]Creative mode toggle for templates fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Switching trains with arrow keys in creative mode now works correctly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.notes: [p]✨ [b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]blue station name boards added as objects[/p][/*][*][p]added CHME3 locomotive[/p][/*][*][p]added quick menu when holding the "Q" key[/p][/*][*][p]compass (F4) can now be toggled on/off[/p][/*][*][p]audio zones added – sounds now differ when the cabin is open or closed[/p][/*][*][p]added fuel station guide – how to operate and refuel diesel trains[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed odometer flickering[/p][/*][*][p]various fixes for track switches[/p][/*][*][p]fixed partial character loading[/p][/*][*][p]destroy tool now correctly shows the object you're aiming at[/p][/*][*][p]fixed inventory and guide visibility from engine view[/p][/*][*][p]improved world loading performance[/p][/*][/list]
